depts.name: Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada
depts.ov: Supports Canada's farmers and food producers. It runs programs that help the sector compete at home and sell abroad, conducts agricultural research at its own research centres and passes new knowledge and technology on to the sector, and provides programs that cushion farmers against financial losses from risks beyond their control, such as drought or market disruption.
depts.ai: Research and agricultural technology adoption are part of the department's science and innovation work.
